kpis.label: Net income (TTM)
kpis.note: GAAP; includes a one-time, non-cash $7.8B loss on converting notes to stock

notes: Q4 FY26 components revenue $649.4M (+103% YoY) and systems revenue $356.9M (+123% YoY); the Q1 FY27 guide midpoint ($1.25B) is more than 130% above a year earlier.

The GAAP net loss comes from swapping part of the 2026, 2028 and 2029 convertible notes for shares in Q4: a one-time, non-cash $7.8B loss on debt extinguishment. Management says it cut convertible debt by $1.1B (about 35%).

runContext.title: The 2025 run
runContext.summary: LITE closed at $49.56 on Apr 4, 2025, its 2025 low, during the tariff selloff. It ended 2025 at $368.59 (+644% from the low) and closed at $1,111.07 on Oct 7, 2026, about 22x the low.
signals: Revenue growth bottomed at −16.9% YoY (Jun 2024 quarter), then +6.1%, +9.7%, +16.0% and +55.9% (Jun 2025 quarter).
Gross margin rose four quarters in a row, from 23.8% to 37.3%.
NVIDIA picked Lumentum as a silicon-photonics laser partner for its co-packaged-optics switches in March 2025.
At the low it traded near 2.3x sales and ~17x forward earnings, after a market-wide (tariff) drop rather than a company problem.
runContext.caveat: Hindsight: the size of the move wasn't knowable in 2025. Today LITE fails the 'not already run' and 'still cheap' parts of the same checklist.

news.title: LITE, COHR, AAOI surge as Lumentum CEO says AI parts sold out through early 2029
news.summary: Lumentum said its optical components are "completely sold out" through early 2029 on AI data-center demand, lifting optical names; LITE closed +5.22% at $1,103.36 after trading as high as $1,143.

news.title: Optics stocks rally on sold-out capacity: AAOI and Lumentum up 7%, Coherent 5%
news.summary: The sold-out signal reversed weeks of profit-taking in optical names; the Roundhill Photonics & Optics ETF (LYTE) rose ~3% vs SPY +0.4% in the morning.

news.title: Lumentum stock lights up AI-fueled buy zone
news.summary: IBD lists LITE on its IBD 50, Big Cap 20, Sector Leaders and Breakout Stocks lists and says top funds are adding shares.

news.title: Lumentum shares fall 7% on AI-slowdown talk
news.summary: Shares fell as much as 7% in the morning on calls to slow AI buildouts and higher oil prices; LITE closed down 2.0% at $1,111.07.

news.title: This photonics stock is already up 600% in one year. Now it's breaking out again
news.summary: A technical analyst sees a breakout from a base dating back to April, with $1,200 as a near-term target and the old $1,000 ceiling as support.

news.title: Lumentum rises on faster NVIDIA optics deployment
news.summary: GF Securities says NVIDIA's co-packaged optics ramp is ahead of expectations; LITE rose 7.4% intraday to $989.51.

news.title: Citi raises Lumentum target to $1,400 from $1,200
news.summary: Citi keeps a Buy and sees optical circuit switches as an $11B opportunity for Lumentum and Coherent.
